Explore Lagos, Abuja & Dublin

Switch cities with the Lagos, Abuja and Dublin tabs. Drag to pan. Scroll or pinch to zoom. Right-drag to rotate the city.

Select a place to look closer, or enter walking mode and move with WASD, arrow keys, or the on-screen controls.

A standalone map recreation based on Lagos Life. The Nigerian maps follow the reference. Dublin is an authored, compressed map inspired by its landmarks, with illustrative shops and service offices. Low-poly building assets by Kenney, as used in the original. This explorer has no connection to game accounts or progress.
